cover_note: Eurotre produce da oltre 40 anni bombole a pressione non ricaricabili per gas compressi e liquefatti, usate e vendute in tutto il mondo.

evidence.quote: It has been operating in the field of production of non-refillable pressure cylinders for compressed and liquefied gases for over 40 years. EUROTRE produces gas vessels that are used and sold in all over the world.
